name: Resume-JD Screening Service
purpose: Recruiters upload a candidate resume and paste a job description. The service extracts facts with an LLM, then computes a fit score (0-100) and a recommendation (Advance / Hold / Reject) with deterministic rules. Every evaluation is stored for audit.
kind: LLM-assisted decision service exposed over a REST API (not a chatbot, no retrieval step)
data_handled: resumes (names, emails, phone numbers, dates of birth)

roles.recruiter: may upload resumes and run evaluations
roles.admin: everything a recruiter can do, plus read saved evaluations, evidence and compliance endpoints

components: PII detection and redaction before text is sent to the LLM
LLM structured extraction (skills matched, domain match, recency)
deterministic scoring and score caps in code
per-evaluation evidence folder: inputs, prompts, answers, model call, app log events, SHA-256 manifest
hash-chained audit log of requests and events
retention report and purge, model-region setting, rules file
data_layout: Each dataset folder holds one JSON file per flow; see the README for commands. The same flows exist in every dataset.
